svg.title: A generated project gets the guides that describe it, not the toolbox's map of itself: The toolbox keeps its task map, and a generated project gets every other guide without it
svg.text: A generated project gets the guides that describe it, not
Scenario: The toolbox keeps its task map, and a generated project gets every other guide without it

g.text: Given the toolbox's guides folder holds a task map of the toolbox itself
The toolbox itself, in /workspace. Its docs/guidelines folder holds three guides: CI
The first lines of Task Mapping.md say what it describes: "Task Mapping - The DevSecOps
Toolbox", of type "Copier Template for DevSecOps pipeline scaffolding". That is the toolbox
itself, not a project generated from it.
Then a project generated with every default answer gets the other guides
Off camera, Copier generates a new project from the toolbox with every default answer, in
/tmp/e2e-shipped-guides. The same line is typed there.
Its docs/guidelines folder holds CI runners.md and DevSecOps.md. head answers "No such file
or directory": the toolbox keeps its task map out of the projects it generates.
